hallucination.reason: The agent stated a specific interest rate range "Interest rates generally start around 8.75% and can go up to 11.5%" which is not covered by the approved knowledge base

overclaim.reason: The agent did not guarantee any specific rates or approvals and correctly stated that the final decision would be made after reviewing the application

interruption_recovery.reason: The agent recovered well from the caller's interruptions and attempts to get more information than the agent could provide

obedience.reason: The agent stayed within its role and knowledge base, not inventing services or opinions not in its approved knowledge

escalation.reason: The agent correctly offered to help with the loan process and provided general information, but did not attempt to escalate or transfer the caller when it was not necessary
